text: Non-reductive physicalists hold that the mental ___ on the physical: there can be no mental difference without some physical difference, even though mental properties are not identical to physical ones.
explanation: Supervenience is the covariance thesis (no mental change without physical change) that lets non-reductive physicalists affirm dependence while denying identity. It is weaker than reduction: it states that the mental covaries with the physical but does not by itself explain why, which is why grounding is often invoked to do the explanatory work.
